summary: Trình engine game 2D/3D nhanh với SDK TypeScript và lõi C++/WebAssembly, hỗ trợ xuất ra web, desktop, WeChat MiniGames và mobile native.
usecases: Building cross-platform 2D/3D games deployable to web, desktop, and mobile from a single codebase.
Creating lightweight playable ads and WeChat MiniGames using WebAssembly execution.
Prototyping ECS-based games with TypeScript logic and C++ performance.
ideas: Integrating WebGPU support for high-performance browser-based 3D graphics.
Using as a foundation for educational game development tools teaching TS + Wasm.
Combining with Firebase/Supabase for serverless multiplayer game backends.
